stem:
In her school laboratory in Pune, Meera directs several parallel rays of sunlight towards four different transparent optical elements, one at a time.
Which element causes the parallel rays to come together and meet at one point after passing through it?

options.text: a thin glass plate with flat, parallel faces
a convex lens that is thicker in the middle
a concave lens that is thinner in the middle
a rectangular glass block placed at a small tilt

teacher.key_rationale: A convex lens converges parallel light beams to a focal point; a thin glass plate and a glass block pass them through essentially unchanged, and a concave lens diverges them. Option A remains the trap for a student who drops the stated condition that the faces are flat and parallel and assumes any transparent object must bend the beams.
